skills.name: pmf-advisor
skills.description: Product-Market Fit advisor for founders and product managers. Applies RICE, JTBD, Value Proposition Canvas, and Sean Ellis Test frameworks to validate ideas and prioritize roadmaps. Aligned with Wavect's 'Build to Sell' philosophy.

skills.name: icp-discovery
skills.description: Ideal Customer Profile discovery coach. Challenges vague ICP assumptions with iterative questions drawn from YC, Steve Blank, Rob Fitzpatrick, and April Dunford. Outputs a behavioral, situational, and economic ICP Card with the beachhead market and riskiest assumption to validate.

skills.name: pricing-strategy
skills.description: Pricing strategy coach for founders. Identifies the right value metric, pricing model (subscription, usage-based, tiered, freemium), and price point using Van Westendorp, WTP interviews, and frameworks from Patrick Campbell, Simon-Kucher, and YC. Outputs a Pricing Strategy Card.

skills.name: qa-advisor
skills.description: In-depth software QA audit skill for AI coding agents. Evaluates test quality (meaningful assertions, correct mocking, builder patterns, regression coverage), maintainability (DRY, SOLID, complexity), security (OWASP Top 10, secrets, injection), and reliability/scalability (error handling, N+1, timeouts, observability). Produces a structured QA Audit Report with severity-graded findings.

skills.name: website-icp-fit
skills.description: Website ICP-fit auditor. Evaluates a website (by URL or source code) against a defined Ideal Customer Profile to determine whether copy, messaging hierarchy, psychological triggers, funnel structure, and trust signals are correctly aligned to convert the right visitor. Applies Schwartz awareness levels, StoryBrand, Cialdini, Fogg Behavior Model, and April Dunford positioning. Outputs a structured conversion audit report.
